title: Global Asymptotics, the Swampland Conjectures, and Preheating of String Moduli
summary: While the cosmological implications of the Swampland Conjectures are usually discussed in the context of inflationary model building, they also have implications for the violent, non-adiabatic dynamics that can follow inflation or any displacement of string moduli. We study this question through the lens of self-resonant preheating, where we point out that two Swampland motivated structures play central roles.
